name: Forests
description: Forests word search puzzles gather woodland English for adults and seniors — canopy, understory, moss, glade, sapling and quiet woods words — without park brands or licensed characters. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays slow and observational: deciduous, conifer, creek, fern, habitat and twilight vocabulary many walkers already know from shaded paths. This hub sits beside our Trees collection and pairs well with Hiking, Birds and National Parks when you want a longer nature session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as soft as dappled light.
